craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Melted-mass likeness venerated; truth/shape double. Rejected: (a) likeness→image → killed: likeness likens. Read aloud: dis-TINC-tions MELT-ed … I-ven-er-ATE.

lines: Distinctions melted, distinction-self, bliss-mass of knowing —
which Your truth, Lord — its likeness, Your shape — I venerate.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vigalitasarvavibhedaṃ sarvavibhedātma cidghanānandam | tasyānukṛtiṃ tvadākṛtiṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Whose imitation is venerated? → Melted-distinction bliss; Your principle imitated in Your form venerated.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
